rows.en: ＊Yoh＊＠２０４＿００４Just came to check on you.￥How's it going?＝＠２０４＿００５Aren't your scores kind of￥terrible?
＊Yoh＊＠２０４＿００６Are you gonna be okay? Won't￥they end up kicking you out of￥here?＝＠２０４＿００７Well, I'm sure keeping up with￥all these experts is tough.
＊Yoh＊＠２０４＿００８Especially for someone like you,￥who doesn't have any specialty.￥Must be rough.
Yeah, it is.
That's harsh!
Yeah, it is.
That's harsh!
＊Yoh＊＠２０４＿００９I feel for you, but it doesn't￥mean much unless your scores￥go up.
＊Yoh＊＠２０４＿０１０Oh, did that sting?￥Sorry, sorry.＝＠２０４＿０１１But it's the truth, right?
＊Yoh＊＠２０４＿０１２You're not an expert, so what￥did they see in you when they￥picked you as a candidate?＝＠２０４＿０１３Does having even abilities mean￥you can do anything?
＊Yoh＊＠２０４＿０１４Isn't that a little￥too convenient?＝＠２０４＿０１５I mean, look at the scores￥you're actually getting.
＊Yoh＊＠２０４＿０１６If you don't try harder, you'll￥let down whoever picked you.
Right. I'll try harder.
Not your business, Yoh!
Right. I'll try harder.
Not your business, Yoh!
＊Yoh＊＠２０４＿０１７Yeah, I think that's best.＝
＊Yoh＊＠２０４＿０１８Whatever your rank, if they see￥you made the effort, they won't￥think badly of you.
＊Yoh＊＠２０４＿０１９Well, sure.￥It's not my business.＝＠２０４＿０２０I just thought I'd give you￥a little advice.＝＠２０４＿０２１Sorry for butting in.
＊Yoh＊＠２０４＿０２２Anyway, things don't look so￥great as they are, do they?＝＠２０４＿０２３You don't have to beat the￥experts, but training a bit more￥would be for your own good.
＊Yoh＊＠２０４＿０２４Why not give it all you've got?￥See ya.
